mapper.sql: SELECT p.id AS projectId, p.version AS projectVersion, p.lifecycle_status AS projectStatus, t.id AS taskId, t.version AS taskVersion, t.status AS taskStatus, c.id AS executionContractId, c.contract_version AS contractVersion, v.id AS planVersionId, e.id AS executionId, e.version AS executionVersion, e.round_no AS roundNo, e.status AS executionStatus, se.id AS stageExecutionId, se.version AS stageExecutionVersion, se.status AS stageExecutionStatus, s.status AS stageStatus, e.started_at AS startedAt FROM proj_project p JOIN proj_project_plan_version v ON v.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND v.project_id=p.id AND v.id=p.active_plan_version_id AND v.status='EFFECTIVE' AND v.deleted=b'0' JOIN proj_project_task t ON t.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND t.project_id=p.id AND t.id=#{query.taskId} AND t.deleted=b'0' JOIN proj_project_task_execution_contract c ON c.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND c.project_task_id=t.id AND c.id=#{query.executionContractId} AND c.current_marker=1 AND c.effective_to IS NULL AND c.deleted=b'0' JOIN proj_project_node_execution e ON e.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND e.project_id=p.id AND e.node_kind='TASK' AND e.node_instance_id=t.id AND e.contract_id=c.id AND CAST(e.node_key AS BINARY)=CAST(c.source_node_key AS BINARY) AND e.plan_version_id=v.id AND e.current_marker=1 AND e.deleted=b'0' JOIN proj_project_stage s ON s.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND s.project_id=p.id AND s.stage_code=t.stage_code AND s.deleted=b'0' JOIN proj_project_node_execution se ON se.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND se.project_id=p.id AND se.node_kind='STAGE' AND se.node_instance_id=s.id AND se.plan_version_id=v.id AND se.current_marker=1 AND se.deleted=b'0' WHERE p.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND p.id=#{query.projectId} AND p.deleted=b'0'
